'''Republican Guard''' was a term used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to describe [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and to distinguish them from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
